errors.text: The proposed refractory-element addition does not reconstruct the target intervention or temperature-dependent simulation protocol.
No refractory element, concentration, incorporation method, coating composition, temperature range, load, speed, or sliding geometry is specified.
The cited evidence does not directly show that adding a refractory element to an otherwise identical HEA coating improves wear resistance across temperatures.
The experiment lacks a quantitative wear metric, acceptance threshold, and explicit result that would falsify the hypothesis.
